WITH c AS (
    INSERT INTO customers (email, name, country, last_contact_at, last_purchase_at)
    VALUES (lower(trim($2)), NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF(upper(trim($4)), ''), now(), now())
    ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE
    SET last_purchase_at = now(), last_contact_at = now(),
        name = COALESCE(customers.name, EXCLUDED.name),
        country = COALESCE(customers.country, EXCLUDED.country)
    RETURNING *
),
w AS (
    UPDATE watches SET status = 'shipped', sold_at = now()
    WHERE id = $1::INT
    RETURNING *
),
p AS (
    INSERT INTO purchases (customer_id, watch_id, sale_price_usd)
    SELECT c.id, w.id, $5::NUMERIC FROM c, w
),
i AS (
    INSERT INTO customer_interests (customer_id, brand, source)
    SELECT c.id, w.brand, 'purchase' FROM c, w
    ON CONFLICT (customer_id, lower(brand), lower(coalesce(reference, ''))) DO NOTHING
),
s AS (
    INSERT INTO shipments (watch_id, customer_id, carrier, tracking_number, destination_country)
    SELECT w.id, c.id, $6, trim($7), NULLIF(upper(trim($8)), '') FROM c, w
    RETURNING *
)
SELECT s.id AS shipment_id, s.carrier, s.tracking_number, c.id AS customer_id, c.name, c.email, c.language,
       w.brand, w.model, w.reference,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'business_name') AS business_name,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email
FROM s, c, w;

INSERT INTO messages_log (customer_id, campaign, subject)
VALUES ($1::INT, 'shipping', $2);

SELECT s.id AS shipment_id, s.tracking_number, s.status,
       c.name, c.email, w.brand, w.reference,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'business_name') AS business_name,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email
FROM shipments s
JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
JOIN watches w   ON w.id = s.watch_id
WHERE s.carrier = 'DHL'
  AND s.status NOT IN ('delivered', 'failure')
  AND s.created_at > now() - INTERVAL '60 days';

UPDATE shipments
SET status = $2, status_detail = $3, updated_at = now(),
    delivered_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'delivered' THEN now() ELSE delivered_at END
WHERE id = $1::INT;

parameters.content:
## Sales & shipping (human first)
**Payment is confirmed by a human.** Then fill the form: the sale is saved (customer database, purchase history, interests), the watch is marked shipped and the customer gets a tracking email.

Every 6 hours DHL shipments are checked (free DHL API key, *Header Auth* `DHL-API-Key`) and the customer is told when the status changes.
